headline: Week 2
body:
Week 2 gave us a 1.5-point heartbreaker, an 84.9-point public execution, some massive Power Ranking swings, and our first official appearance of the Fraud Department™.
Some teams are cooking. Some teams are getting cooked. And one team scored 188.4, which feels frankly unnecessary.

⚔️ MATCHUPS
MayeBe Tuten MayeBe Brown 110.8 def. Heavy is the head 👑 109.3
Absolute robbery. Heavy is the head 👑 lost by 1.5 points, which is the fantasy equivalent of watching your Uber drive past you and cancel the ride. MayeBe Tuten MayeBe Brown escapes with the win despite sitting at #11 in the Power Rankings, proving you don't have to be good—you just have to be slightly less bad than the guy you're playing.

My Dog Is Cuter Than Toms 188.4 def. Goedert? Hardly know her! 103.5
Jesus Christ. My Dog Is Cuter Than Toms dropped 188.4, won by 84.9, took the week's high score AND the blowout award, and moved into the #1 Power Ranking spot. Goedert? Hardly know her! basically showed up to a gunfight holding a Capri Sun.

12th Mans 3rd Leg 110.5 def. ssssssspencer 104
Not pretty. Not impressive. Still counts. 12th Mans 3rd Leg follows up last week's 173.6 explosion with 110.5 and somehow still walks away victorious, while ssssssspencer remains trapped at the bottom of the Power Rankings despite getting a respectable 104.

I Chase Brown Kids 146.4 def. Strib club closed 114.1
I Chase Brown Kids apparently took the Week 1 loss personally. A 146.4 rebound launches them four spots to #3 in the Power Rankings, while Strib club closed once again discovers that scoring over 110 points does not actually matter when the other guy scores 146.

Kittle Down The Middle 155.4 def. Hawk Nacua Spit on Thang 127.3
Kittle Down The Middle woke up angry. 155.4 points, the week's second-highest score, and a ridiculous five-spot jump to #5 in the Power Rankings. Meanwhile, Hawk Nacua Spit on Thang drops 127.3 and loses anyway—the fantasy gods continue to personally hate this team.

Caleb NotNuhnuhnuhnotgay 111.3 def. Malik My Balls 92.6
Caleb NotNuhnuhnuhnotgay moves to another win with an extremely pedestrian 111.3, while Malik My Balls follows last week's 139.6 with a brutal 92.6. The result? Malik plummets five spots to #10, while Caleb remains comfortably seated inside the league's Fraud Investigation Unit.

📊 POWER RANKINGS
#1 My Dog Is Cuter Than Toms — 97.3, ↑1 188.4 points. There isn't much investigative journalism required here.
#2 12th Mans 3rd Leg — 86.4, ↓1 Falls out of the top spot despite winning. Apparently the algorithm watched that 110.5 and said, “Yeah… we're good.”
#3 I Chase Brown Kids — 77, ↑4 Biggest statement of the week. From #7 to #3 after dropping 146.4.
#4 Hawk Nacua Spit on Thang — 69.3, ↑2 The standings say pain. The Power Rankings say contender.
#5 Kittle Down The Middle — 60, ↑5 The biggest riser of Week 2. Apparently scoring 155.4 is a decent way to fix your résumé.
#6 Heavy is the head 👑 — 53.2, ↓2 Lost by 1.5 and gets punished with a two-spot drop. Cold world.
#7 Goedert? Hardly know her! — 41.8, ↓4 Hard to stay near the top after allowing yourself to become the centerpiece of an 84.9-point crime scene.
#8 Caleb NotNuhnuhnuhnotgay — 41.4 The wins keep coming. The computer remains deeply suspicious.
#9 Strib club closed — 32.7 At some point the club may need to consider reopening.
#10 Malik My Balls — 20.9, ↓5 No team fell further this week. From Week 1 winner to 92.6-point disaster movie.
#11 MayeBe Tuten MayeBe Brown — 15.5 Won the game. Still ranked #11. Enjoy the three seconds of happiness before checking the rankings.
#12 ssssssspencer — 4.5 The algorithm has spoken, and apparently it has a personal vendetta.

🚨 STORYLINES
🎭 FRAUD WATCH: Caleb NotNuhnuhnuhnotgay
Standings: #3. Power Ranking: #8.
Nothing says “sustainable success” quite like sitting near the top of the standings while the Power Ranking model quietly whispers, this can't keep happening.
The wins are real. The respect has not arrived.
📈 BETTER THAN THE RECORD: Hawk Nacua Spit on Thang
Standings: #10. Power Ranking: #4.
This is the guy sitting at the blackjack table saying, “I'm actually playing really well,” while actively losing money.
The difference is… the numbers agree. Hawk Nacua Spit on Thang is somehow sitting at #10 in the standings while grading out as the #4 team.

🏆 WEEK 2 AWARDS
🥇 HIGH SCORE
My Dog Is Cuter Than Toms — 188.4
Complete annihilation.
😬 CLOSEST MATCHUP
MayeBe Tuten MayeBe Brown 110.8 vs Heavy is the head 👑 109.3
1.5 points.
Somewhere on Heavy's roster is one meaningless dropped pass that will now be remembered forever.
☠️ BLOWOUT OF THE WEEK
My Dog Is Cuter Than Toms by 84.9
At some point this stopped being fantasy football and became cyberbullying.

👑 POSITION LEADERS
QB — My Dog Is Cuter Than Toms: 76.5 Apparently having the highest-scoring team wasn't enough.
RB — Kittle Down The Middle: 94.3 The running backs put the entire franchise on their backs.
WR — I Chase Brown Kids: 104.7 Triple-digit WR production is disgusting behavior.
TE — Heavy is the head 👑: 42.6 The tight ends did their job. Please direct all complaints regarding the 1.5-point loss elsewhere.
FLEX — My Dog Is Cuter Than Toms: 76.2 Yes, they're here again.
K — ssssssspencer: 31 Your weekly reminder that ssssssspencer is #12 in the Power Rankings but apparently employs Justin Tucker's entire extended family.
DEF — Heavy is the head 👑: 30 TE leader. DEF leader. Lost by 1.5. Fantasy football is a deeply unserious activity.

🔮 THREE THINGS TO WATCH IN WEEK 3
1. Is Caleb NotNuhnuhnuhnuhnotgay actually good? The standings say #3. The Power Rankings say #8. Eventually one of them has to blink.
2. How long can Hawk Nacua Spit on Thang keep getting screwed? A #4 Power Ranking paired with a #10 standing is the exact recipe for a manager slowly losing his mind in the group chat.
3. Is My Dog Is Cuter Than Toms about to run away with this thing? A 97.3 Power Ranking and 188.4 in Week 2 officially puts a giant target on their back. Congratulations on becoming the team everyone now desperately wants to beat.

🎤 COMMISSIONER'S CLOSING STATEMENT
Two weeks down.
We have fraud allegations, one extremely unfortunate #10/#4 standings-to-power-ranking situation, ssssssspencer leading the league in kicker production while sitting dead last in the Power Rankings, and My Dog Is Cuter Than Toms dropping 188.4 like someone accidentally set the difficulty to Rookie.
Week 3 starts now.
Set your lineups. Check your injury reports. And please, for the love of God, somebody score 189 on My Dog Is Cuter Than Toms.
